tools.name: clone
tools.description: Clone a repository into `dir`. Idempotent: if `dir` already holds a checkout of the same remote, fetches instead of failing. The credential is supplied by the runtime and never appears in the URL you pass.

repoUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the repository, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo

dir.description: Absolute path to clone into. Created if absent.

commands.command: git -c credential.helper= -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$(printenv GH_TOKEN)" | base64 -w0)" clone "UTCP_ARG_repoUrl_UTCP_END" "UTCP_ARG_dir_UTCP_END" 2>&1 || git -C "UTCP_ARG_dir_UTCP_END" fetch --all --prune 2>&1

tools.name: status
tools.description: Porcelain status of the checkout at `cwd`, plus the current branch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch all remotes and prune deleted branches.

commands.command: git -C "UTCP_ARG_cwd_UTCP_END" -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$(printenv GH_TOKEN)" | base64 -w0)" fetch --all --prune 2>&1

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Check out `branch` in the checkout at `cwd`, creating it off `base` when it does not exist yet. Use for both the fresh case and the resume case.

base.description: Ref to branch from when `branch` does not exist, e.g. origin/dev.

tools.name: merge
tools.description: Merge `ref` into the current branch. Merge, never rebase — a feature branch's commits may already be on a pull request, and rebasing them rewrites history someone is already reviewing.

ref.description: Ref to merge in, e.g. origin/dev.

tools.name: commit_all
tools.description: Stage everything and commit with `message`. Succeeds quietly when there is nothing staged, so a caller need not check first.

authorName.description: Author name recorded on the commit.

authorEmail.description: Author email recorded on the commit.

commands.command: git -C "UTCP_ARG_cwd_UTCP_END" -c user.name="UTCP_ARG_authorName_UTCP_END" -c user.email="UTCP_ARG_authorEmail_UTCP_END" commit -m "UTCP_ARG_message_UTCP_END" 2>&1 || echo "nothing to commit"

tools.name: push
tools.description: Push the current branch to origin, setting upstream. Uses `--force-with-lease`, which refuses to overwrite work that appeared on the remote since this checkout last saw it — a plain force would silently discard someone else's commit.

commands.command: git -C "UTCP_ARG_cwd_UTCP_END" -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$(printenv GH_TOKEN)" | base64 -w0)" push --force-with-lease --set-upstream origin "UTCP_ARG_branch_UTCP_END" 2>&1

tools.name: log
tools.description: One-line log of the last `count` commits on the current branch.

tools.name: rev_parse
tools.description: Resolve a ref to its full sha in the checkout at `cwd`.

ref.description: Ref to resolve, e.g. HEAD or origin/main.
